data.name: Bartel
data.gender_notes: Bartel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'barth', meaning spear. In the Middle Ages, Bartel was a common name for knights due to its association with bravery and martial prowess. The name Bartel carries the meaning “Bright as a spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bartel usually hope their child will grow to embody bright as a spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are bold in their faith and steadfast in their convictions.
data.etymology: Bartel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright as a spear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bartel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_english.name: Bartel

Additionally, the name can inspire us to live lives that are honorable and reflect the courage and strength of our faith.
